title: Geekvape Supermesh X2 coil 0.4ohm
description: The bestselling Cerberus sub-ohm tank from Geekvape can handle any high-VG eliquid you throw at it and comes with adjustable airflow, a mess-free top-fill system and is compatible with GeekVape’s super mesh coils for long-lasting, incredible flavour and cloud production. The new and improved Supermesh X2 coils are designed for use with the Cerberus tank and feature larger wick ports and a 0.4ohm resistance for incredible flavour, performance and lifespan. For sub-ohm vaping with High-VG e-liquid.
